name: ASTERIAL
releaseNotes: Multi-product Phase 1 architecture separating the Next.js full-stack website and dedicated React Native Android application (com.xhuracan.asterial)
Shared @asterial/core TypeScript package unifying database contracts, Phase 2+ social models, Zod validation, and theme tokens
Dedicated React Native 0.83 + Hermes native Android foundation connected directly to Supabase Auth & PostgreSQL RLS (zero WebView)
Automated GitHub Actions pipeline validating @asterial/core, Next.js Web, and compiling the React Native Android APK
Full preservation of existing 1:1 & group real-time messaging, private Storage signed URLs, and four-theme visual system
